tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
IMPORTANT NOTE: MINIMUM SERVICE CHARGE SHOULD BE BETWEEN 2% AND 5%
Remaining all other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: THE BIDDER SHOULD FURNISH ALL TECHNICAL DOCUMENT AS MENTIONED IN THE TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Affidavit copy for stating that Agency is not blacklisted/politically affiliated/having no court litigation- to be submit in Rs 500 notarized stamp paper
Agency PAN and GST Number should not be changed for last 5 years
Chartered Accountant attested Balance Sheet for FY 2023-2024 and 2024-2025
Document pertaining to Labour Welfare Fund for last 3 years
EPF registration Certificate and PF Challan of 160 employees for April 2026, May 2025 and June 2026
ESI registration Certificate and ESI Challan of 160 employees for April 2026, May 2025 and June 2026
GST Registration Certificate and GST Challan for April 2026, May 2025 and June 2026
License from Labor Department as per Regulation and Abolition Act 1970 - atleast 160 employees to be registered
Name of the Tenderer and Firms full address/Contact number/email id in letter hea
Notarized affidavit in Rs 500 bond paper stating that salary will be paid to employees for three months even though there is delay in budget release
Professional Tax Registration Certificate and PT payment challan for FY 2025-2026

Satisfactory letter from 4 Govt and Semi Govt department having minimum 160 employees and agencies should compulsorily upload satisfactory performance certificate from present govt department without fail
Whether agency is Sole proprietorship/Partnership, attach relevant document
Whether registered under Societies Registration Act/Companies Act/Cooperative Societies Act - Attach Relevant Certificate
